verification_categories_derived_from_spe: Frame header generation — Break (≥13 dominant bit times) + Break Delimiter (≥1 recessive) + Sync (0x55) + PID with correct P0/P1 parity, all at master's nominal bit rate.
Frame response — 1..8 data bytes transmitted by publisher; checksum computed and appended.
PID parity — sweep all 64 IDs and confirm each produces the PID byte in Table 2.4.
Classic checksum — sum-with-carry over data bytes, inverted; verify against {0x4A,0x55,0x93,0xE5} → 0xE6.
Enhanced checksum — sum-with-carry over PID + data bytes; only for LIN 2.x non-diagnostic frames.
Slave self-synchronisation — slave correctly measures master's T_Bit from the 0x55 Sync byte and receives the PID + data + checksum within bit-rate tolerance.
Break detection threshold — 11 bit times (or 9.5 for tight-tolerance slaves).
Unconditional frame slot — publisher always responds within T_Frame_Maximum.
Event-triggered frame slot — publisher responds only if signal updated; collisions trigger automatic switch to collision-resolving schedule.
Sporadic frame slot — silent unless a signal updated; otherwise highest-priority pending unconditional frame transmitted.
Diagnostic frame slot — IDs 0x3C / 0x3D, classic checksum, 8 data bytes, transport-layer SF / FF / CF PDUs.
Reserved frame IDs 0x3E / 0x3F — shall not be transmitted in a LIN 2.x cluster.
Schedule table — slot timing satisfies T_Frame_Slot > jitter + T_Frame_Maximum; schedule switches honoured only at slot boundaries.
Schedule wraparound — active schedule cyclically processed.
Initialisation timing — slave init completes within 100 ms.
Wake-up — dominant pulse 250 µs to 5 ms wakes all slaves; ≥150 µs detection threshold; slaves ready within 100 ms; retry silences 150-250 ms; ≥1.5 s after 3 failed attempts.
Go-To-Sleep — master-request frame (PID 0x3C) with data1=0, data2..8=0xFF puts cluster into Bus sleep mode.
Implicit sleep — slave auto-enters Bus sleep mode after 4-10 s of bus inactivity.
response_error signal — set on framing / bit / checksum / PID-parity / no-response error on a non-event-triggered slot; cleared once carrying unconditional frame transmitted.
Error_in_response and Successful_transfer flags — set correctly per slot outcome.
Bit error on TX — UART readback mismatch aborts no later than end of mismatching byte field.
LIN 1.3 / LIN 2.x interoperability — master refrains from enhanced-checksum, reconfig/diag, automatic baud-rate detection, response_error monitoring on LIN 1.3 slaves.
Node configuration services — Assign NAD, Conditional Change NAD, Data Dump, Save Configuration, Assign frame ID range.
Read by Identifier service — returns Supplier ID, Function ID, Variant + ECU-specific identifiers.
Transport-layer multi-frame — FF + CF sequence carries payloads up to 4095 bytes.
fields.notes: The LIN spec does not include a packaged compliance testbench. Categories above are derived from sections 2.3, 2.4, 2.5, 2.6, 2.7, 2.8, chapter 3 (transport), chapter 4 (node config), chapter 5 (diagnostics) and section 6 (physical layer).
